lines.intro: The power's down on Floor {repairFloor} and the repair crew needs this lift. Press DOOR OPEN to wake her up.
lines.introDone: There she is. Lights, doors, motor. Let's get to work.
lines.reposition: Next call is on Floor {floor}. Hold on.
lines.hallCall: We've got a call on Floor {floor}. Press {floor} to pick it up.
lines.cuedFirst: We're on Floor {start}. The repair kit is {change} floors {dir}. Press the floor where it is.
lines.cuedNext: Floor {start}. The toolbox is {change} floors {dir}. Take us there.
lines.shaft: Shaft map time. We're at Floor {start}. The spare parts are {change} floors {dir}. Tap their floor on the map, or use the panel.
lines.stretch: The crew radioed: "We're {change} floors {rel} the beacon." The beacon is on Floor {start}.
lines.encounterRoute: Big job. The loading dock is {change} floors {rel} Floor {start}, where we are now.
lines.cargo: Load the car. It can carry {capacity} units. {aboard} are already aboard. Load as many as can safely go, then press DOOR CLOSE.
lines.finale: Full load. Take us to Floor {repairFloor}.
lines.finaleOnlyRepair: The crew is waiting on Floor {repairFloor}.
lines.arrivedWrong: We reached Floor {floor}. The job is {change} floors {dir} from Floor {start}.
lines.arrivedWrongBeacon: We reached Floor {floor}. The crew is {change} floors {rel} the beacon on Floor {start}.
lines.tryFromHere: Check the panel again. We can go from here.
lines.regenerated: New call coming in. A different job, same kind.
lines.overload: Overload. The car only takes {capacity} units in total. Take some off.
lines.underload: Safe to go, but the crew needs every unit we can carry. There is room for more.
lines.emptyLoad: Load the crates first. Drag them into the car.
lines.complete: Floor {repairFloor} has power again. That was real engineering.
lines.completeAgain: Floor {repairFloor} is running again. Ride anywhere you like.
lines.rankEarned: Engineer Rank 1. Your Engineer Log is on the clipboard. Ride anywhere you like.
lines.freeRide: The lift is all yours. Ride anywhere.
lines.doorCloseTip: Operator trick: DOOR CLOSE gets us moving sooner.
lines.logUnknown: Something here is worth a look.
lines.saveStuck: The logbook will not save right now. A grown-up can help.
lines.troubleBody: Everything saved before this moment is safe. TRY AGAIN reloads the game from the last save.

praise.afterMiss: You changed your plan. That worked.
praise.afterRescue: You worked it out yourself after the test run.
praise.stretch: You worked out where the beacon was. Nicely done.
praise.cargo: Load accepted: the car is exactly full.

misconceptions.quantity.countedStartingPosition: One floor short. Floor {start} is where we start. Count the floors after {start}.
misconceptions.quantity.countedOneExtra: One floor too far. The first floor {dir} from {start} is {first}. Count from there.
misconceptions.quantity.reversedDirection: We went the wrong way. The job is {dir} from Floor {start}, not {dirOpposite}.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithChange: {change} is how many floors to move, not where we stop. Start at {start} and move {change}.
misconceptions.quantity.ignoredExistingLoad: {aboard} units were already aboard before we loaded anything.
misconceptions.quantity.loadedEverything: Not everything fits in one trip. The car holds {capacity}.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithExistingLoad: We loaded as many as were already aboard. Check how much room is left.

highlightGiven.label: CLUE
highlightGiven.altLine: The plate says {capacity} units maximum. {aboard} are already in the car. How much room is left?

numberLine.label: SHAFT MAP
numberLine.line: The shaft map shows every floor. Find {start}, then count {change} {dir}.
numberLine.altLine: The load meter shows each unit. Count up to the red line.

countStrategy.label: HOW TO COUNT
countStrategy.line: Put your finger on Floor {start}. The next floor {dir} is 1, the one after is 2. Keep counting until you reach {change}.

showAnswer.label: SHOW ME
showAnswer.line: It's Floor {revealed}. {start} and {change} {dir}. Press it and watch the indicator.

lines.intro: Quick test run before the real job.
lines.general: When the lift moves, we count each floor we pass, starting after the floor we're on.
lines.generalFill: The car has a limit. We count the empty spaces left, one at a time.
lines.example: Test run: we start on Floor {exStart} and move {exChange} floors {exDir}. Tap the next floor.
lines.exampleFill: Test car: it holds {exCapacity}. {exAboard} are already in it. Tap the next empty space.
lines.notNext: Try the floor right next to the last one we counted.
lines.ask: We made {exChange} moves. So where does the lift stop?
lines.askFill: So how many more fit in the test car?
lines.exampleRight: Floor {exAnswer}. {exChange} moves, and the floor we started on was not one of them.
lines.exampleRightFill: {exAnswer} more. The ones already aboard were not counted again.
lines.exampleRetry: Let's count once more. The first floor after {exStart} is move 1.
lines.back: Now the real job. Same idea: we're on Floor {start}, the job is {change} floors {dir}. Where do we stop?
lines.backBeacon: Now the real job. The beacon is on Floor {start}. The crew is {change} floors {rel} it. Where do we stop?
lines.backFill: Now the real car. It holds {capacity}. {aboard} are aboard. Load what still fits.

focus.quantity.countedStartingPosition: The floor where we START is not one of the moves.
focus.quantity.countedOneExtra: We stop as soon as the count reaches the number of moves.
focus.quantity.reversedDirection: Up means bigger floor numbers. Down means smaller ones.
focus.quantity.answeredWithChange: The number of moves is not a floor. We start somewhere and move from there.
focus.quantity.ignoredExistingLoad: The units already aboard take up space too.
focus.quantity.loadedEverything: The limit is the most the car can hold, whatever is waiting.

replay.decompose: One quick way: 5 first, then the rest. {path}.
replay.distance: Check it: from {result} up to {start} is {change} floors.
replay.numberLineObserved: You found it on the shaft map: {path}.
